title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan: Valuing Gross-Only Earnings Lines by the Worker's Own Net Ratio
content:
**Earnings valuation note — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, next-business-day transfers to the worker's bank account.**

For the bank accrued net, a regular-hours or shift-differential sync line whose net basis is estimated from gross may be valued again as the estimate method below provides, and every other line counts at its recorded net amount.

**The estimate method** sets the value of the regular-hours and shift-differential sync lines estimated from gross that count in the bank accrued net. It looks at the regular-hours sync lines with net basis employer-reported net that carry the pay date of the plan's latest period close line:

1. when those lines number at least **4** and none of them carries a gross amount of zero, the estimated lines' gross amount in total is multiplied by the worker's own net ratio — the net amount of those employer-reported lines over their gross amount — and rounded down to the cent once;
2. when they number one to three and none carries a gross amount of zero, that total gross is multiplied by the average of the worker's own net ratio and the gross-to-net estimation percentage expressed as a fraction (that percentage divided by one hundred), and rounded down to the cent once;
3. otherwise the estimated lines count at their recorded net amount.

| Employer-reported regular-hours lines of the last closed pay period | Any of them with a zero gross | Value of the estimated lines |
|---|---|---|
| 4 or more | no | total gross times the worker's own net ratio, rounded down once |
| 1 to 3 | no | total gross times the average of the own ratio and the estimation fraction, rounded down once |
| any number | yes | recorded net amounts |
| none | — | recorded net amounts |

## Hypothetical cases

- Five employer-reported lines last period, net 612.00 USD over gross 850.00 USD: own ratio 0.72. Estimated lines this period with a total gross of 287.35 USD are valued at 287.35 times 0.72, 206.892, rounded down once to 206.89 USD.
- Two employer-reported lines, net 300.00 USD over gross 400.00 USD: own ratio 0.75; with an estimation percentage of 70, the average is 0.725, and an estimated gross of 287.35 USD is valued at 208.32 USD (208.32875 rounded down).
- One of the employer-reported lines shows a gross of 0.00 USD: the estimated lines stay at their recorded net amounts.
